verdict.rationale: Speculative decoding is a fair performance axis for a local LLM runtime like LM Studio, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions it. There is no draft-model pairing and no documented generation-speed technique of this kind. The only related controls are GPU offload and context-length flags on `lms load`, which are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate generation speed using speculative decoding techniques
